subject: Ancestral shape from Phylomorphospace to plotRefToTarget

messages.author: 0505f504492a4cae
messages.subject: Ancestral shape from Phylomorphospace to plotRefToTarget
parts:
Hello, 

I am wondering if there is a way to visualize the ancestral shape of a phylogeny to a specified tip using the plotRefToTarget function. I currently have code which uses plotRefToTarget to show wireframes of extremes between the min/max of a given PC. Is there a way to extract node shape data from a phylomorphospace generated from gm.prcomp? 

Best, 

Maddy

messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] Ancestral shape from Phylomorphospace to plotRefToTarget
parts:
Maddy,

 

Please see the help file from gm.prcomp.  If using a phylogeny in that function, ancestral states for nodes are output as part of the object that is returned.


Dean

 

Dr. Dean C. Adams

Hello and thank you Dr. Adams,

Ah! , I am not sure how I missed that. This is extremely helpful but, as phyPCA$ancestors is output as a matrix (with nodes as rows and x,y,z coords as columns), it is not in a format that can be directly used in plotRefToTarget. I can extract data from a single row (=node) with phyPCA$ancestors['169',] but this is a vector. How can I extract this data in a way that I can use similar to my Y.gpa$coords. Apologies if I am once again missing something obvious. 

Best, 

Maddy
